content: {"episode_id":"ep-05010","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, for episode ep-05010. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope (R55) in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10) and unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91). Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or ischemic changes that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring, as stated in the indication note. We request reconsideration of the CO-197 determination on the basis of this documented medical necessity."}
